annotations.title: Add the event pass to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet

description: For "what is my pass status", "did my pass save", "my pass", "where is my Wallet pass", "send my pass again": call this tool. Returns a link that adds the person's pass for an event or a personal event served here to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet ("add it to my wallet", "I want the pass on my phone"). Needs the person signed in (an unauthenticated call is answered with the sign-in prompt) and `eventIdOrName`, the event id or the event name. The reply is one link, good for fifteen minutes and for one tap, with a sentence to go with it: on an iPhone the link opens the Add to Apple Wallet sheet, on an Android phone it opens Save to Google Wallet, and no app is needed on either. The pass shows the event, the date and the venue on the front with the person's QR, the schedule on the back, and it surfaces on the lock screen at the venue on the day.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id (lbtw_2026, test_wedding_a_garden) or the event NAME as the organizer or the hosts spell it.
